I'll be making the binding disposition decision on this batch, but as we all know, nothing ships or returns to production until the hold is formally resolved. Let's go through our standard fact-recording routine. I'd like to start with the process owner -- please give us your concise update on what happened with the oven temperature alarm during this batch run.
